{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
# These are not real orders and distort the mean
valid_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue for valid completed orders
mean_revenue_valid = valid_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_orders.shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99].shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of valid completed orders (after removing QA): {valid_completed.shape[0]}")
print(f"Mean revenue of valid completed orders: {mean_revenue_valid}")"}
